games:2026-wk9-utah-cincinnati.blurb: No. 6 Utah goes on the road to Cincinnati as a 7-point favorite, with ESPN pegging the Utes at 70.8%. Utah leads the Big 12 race and can't afford a slip against an unranked host.

games:2026-wk9-mississippi-state-texas.blurb: No. 11 Texas is a 20.5-point home favorite over Mississippi State and a 90.1% pick per ESPN. The Longhorns jumped eight spots in the poll this week and this is a chance to keep the climb going.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-minnesota-india.blurb: No. 4 Indiana hosts Minnesota as a 20.5-point favorite with the total down at 40.5. The Hoosiers sit two spots behind Ohio State in the Big Ten race and can't let one slip.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-texas-state-boi.blurb: No. 20 Boise State closes out the night at home against Texas State, favored by 10.5 with a 63.5 total that suggests points. ESPN has the Broncos at 86.2%.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-miami-north-car.blurb: No. 1 Miami travels to North Carolina as a 14-point favorite and an 89.8% pick. The Hurricanes have the top spot to protect in a night-window road game.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-northwestern-or.blurb: No. 21 Northwestern is a 3.5-point underdog at Oregon in one of the tightest lines of the day. ESPN gives the Ducks 70.2% despite the short number, making this a real danger spot for both.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-missouri-arkans.blurb: No. 23 Missouri goes to Arkansas as a 10-point road favorite with ESPN at 73.8% for the Tigers. A late SEC kickoff with ranking implications for Mizzou.

predictions:kentucky.blurb: Kentucky climbed from 12th to 9th and now sits as the SEC's closest chaser behind Georgia, though the computers are cooler on the Wildcats than the poll is (31st in SP+, 24th in FPI).

predictions:texas.blurb: Texas made the week's biggest jump, 19th to 11th, and the metrics back it up completely: eighth in both SP+ and FPI.

predictions:tennessee.blurb: Tennessee slid from 11th to 16th in the poll even as the advanced numbers keep the Vols in the low teens (11th SP+, 12th FPI).

predictions:lsu.blurb: LSU moved up to 15th and the metrics think that's still too low -- third in SP+ and seventh in FPI make the Tigers one of the most underrated teams on the board.

bubbleNotes:lsu.blurb: LSU is the last team in the bubble group at 16, four spots from the field, but the Tigers moved up three and are headed the right direction.

games:2026-wk9-florida-georgia.blurb: The rivalry renews with No. 3 Georgia laying 12.5 on No. 17 Florida and a total of 56.5 on the board. ESPN's model gives the Bulldogs an 81.8% shot, but the Gators arrive ranked and with a chance to blow up the SEC picture.

games:2026-wk9-arizona-texas-tech.blurb: No. 22 Arizona at No. 13 Texas Tech is the tightest ranked matchup on the slate, with the Red Raiders favored by just 3.5 and a 54.5 total. Texas Tech is sitting on the playoff bubble, so a home stumble against a ranked Big 12 foe would sting.

games:2026-wk9-auburn-ole-miss.blurb: Ole Miss is a 10.5-point favorite over unranked Auburn with the number set at 58.5, one of the highest totals of the day. The No. 12 Rebels are a single spot outside the playoff field, so style points matter as much as the win.

games:2026-wk9-virginia-wake-forest.blurb: No. 14 Wake Forest hosts Virginia as a 12.5-point favorite in a low-total game (47.5), with ESPN giving the Demon Deacons an 81.3% chance. Wake is climbing the bubble and can't afford a letdown spot against an unranked ACC opponent.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-smu-syracuse.blurb: No. 19 SMU goes on the road to Syracuse as an 8.5-point favorite with a 58.5 total that suggests points on both sides. The Mustangs need to keep the ACC resume clean against an unranked but dangerous host.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-notre-dame-navy.blurb: No. 5 Notre Dame is favored by 30.5 in this rivalry meeting with Navy, with the total set at 54.5. Anything less than a comfortable afternoon would be a talking point for a team this high in the rankings.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-ohio-state-usc.blurb: No. 2 Ohio State heads west to USC as a 6.5-point favorite in a 50.5-total night game, with ESPN giving the Buckeyes an 82.7% win probability. The Big Ten lead is on the line against an unranked team capable of flipping the race.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-nevada-ucla.blurb: No. 7 UCLA welcomes Nevada as a 22.5-point favorite with a modest 42.5 total and a 93.6% ESPN win probability. This is a hold-serve spot for a Bruins team that just moved up in the rankings.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-arizona-state-b.blurb: No. 8 BYU is a 16.5-point home favorite over Arizona State, with ESPN pegging the Cougars at 89.7%. BYU is chasing Utah in the Big 12 race, so a clean win keeps the pressure on.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-wisconsin-iowa.blurb: No. 25 Wisconsin is actually a 2.5-point underdog at Iowa in a game with a 35.5 total, which tells you exactly what kind of afternoon to expect. Field position and a single possession could decide whether the Badgers stay ranked.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-oklahoma-state-.blurb: No. 24 Oklahoma State is a 9.5-point road favorite at Iowa State with a 58.5 total and a 70.4% ESPN win probability. The Cowboys are the rare ranked team favored by more than a touchdown away from home.

predictions:ucla.blurb: UCLA climbed from No. 9 to No. 7 and the advanced numbers are split on the Bruins: SP+ has them 17th, FPI 31st. The Big Ten schedule will settle which number is telling the truth.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-ten.blurb: The Big Ten's auto bid is a two-horse sprint: No. 2 Ohio State leads with No. 4 Indiana just two spots back. Any Buckeye slip and the Hoosiers are right there to take it.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: No. 6 Utah holds the Big 12's automatic bid with No. 8 BYU only two spots behind. That's close enough that one bad Saturday swings the league.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: No. 3 Georgia has the most comfortable lead of any conference, six spots clear of No. 9 Kentucky for the SEC's automatic bid. The Wildcats need help, not just wins.

bubbleNotes:ole-miss.blurb: Ole Miss sits at the 13 seed, one spot from the field, after sliding five places. The Rebels are first in line if anyone above them stumbles.

bubbleNotes:texas-tech.blurb: Texas Tech fell five spots to the 14 seed and is now two spots outside the field. Next up is a ranked opponent in No. 22 Arizona, which is exactly the kind of win that gets them back in.

bubbleNotes:wake-forest.blurb: Wake Forest moved up three spots to the 15 seed but is still three out of the field. The Demon Deacons need to keep stacking wins to finish the climb.
